accepted_partials: Finite invariant configurations of size at least two exclude presyndeticity.
Extremely amenable presyndetic certificates have exactly one fixed point, no other finite orbit, and are non-co-precompact and nonnormal inside that point stabilizer.
Restriction of continuous homogeneous quasimorphisms to presyndetic subgroups is injective.
remaining_gap: No affirmative certificate or negative compact counterflow was established for either target; no applicable general vanishing result on arbitrary topologically extremely amenable subgroups was established.
